test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In January 2022, the Supreme Court of India quashed the one-year suspension of 12 MLAs, belonging to the state of _________, who had been suspended for ‘disorderly conduct’.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maharashtra.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court of India quashed the one-year suspension of 12 MLAs belonging to **Maharashtra**.
 
• The Suspended MLAs belong to Bhartiya Janta Party.
 
• Under **Rule 53 of the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly Rules,** the power to suspend can only be exercised by the Speaker, and it cannot be put to vote in a resolution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Additional Points of Maharashtra.**__

 
 
• ​Chief Minister: Eknath Sambhaji Shinde
 
• Governor: Ramesh Bais.
 
• High Court: The High Court of Bombay.
 
• State Bird: Yellow Footed Green Pigeon.
 
• State Animal: Indian Giant Squirrel.
